description: Cognee is the open-source AI memory platform for agents. Give your AI agents persistent long-term memory with small models for free
summary: Cognee ingests documents, code, and conversation logs into a self-hosted knowledge graph using local GLiNER extraction and local embeddings, then lets an agent query that graph across sessions without a single API call. That's exactly the missing layer in PenguPool, where I'm routing a dozen agent sessions and need durable, structured context that survives a restart instead of re-reading the same files every run. Coming from bioinformatics, I also like that it supports custom ontologies rather than dumping everything into a flat vector store, which is how the good pathway databases have always been built.
